prompt: A black-and-white typographic poster in portrait format, vintage Victorian hand-lettered artwork on a solid black background with tiny scattered white specks. Four lines of white lettering are stacked in one tall column in the center of the poster, with wide empty black margins around it. At the top, the words "QUIET WORK" are written in medium decorative vintage serif capitals, as two words side by side on one line. Directly beneath it, the word "BUILDS" is written in small serif capitals. Below it, the word "LOUD" is written in very large decorative vintage serif capitals with an oversized first letter and slightly playful letter heights. At the bottom, the word "RESULTS" is written in the same decorative vintage serif capitals. Main lines are much larger than the small connecting words. Thin ornamental rules made of dotted lines and small curled scrolls separate the lines, and symmetrical Victorian flourish ornaments sit above the top line and below the bottom line. The poster shows only these five words, each of them once, in pure white and black with no other colors, and no other lettering below the last line.
